sections.content: Use descriptive adjectives and relative clauses with *que* to identify places, species and environmental features. A relative clause lets you add information without starting a new sentence.

items.spanish: El bosque que está cerca del pueblo es muy tranquilo.
items.english: The forest that is near the village is very peaceful.

items.spanish: El río, que atraviesa la ciudad, necesita protección.
items.english: The river, which crosses the city, needs protection.

items.spanish: Hay especies que viven en esta zona.
items.english: There are species that live in this area.

items.spanish: Es un lugar donde muchas personas pasean.
items.english: It is a place where many people walk.

sections.content: Use *que* for people and things when adding identifying information, and *donde* for places.
